summary: The page displays clean alignment overall, but suffers from floating overlay elements occluding active terminal text lines at the bottom of the main console view.

issues.title: Console log collision with bottom controls
issues.description: Floating status and action controls overlap the trailing terminal log lines, reducing readability.
issues.evidence: The 'streaming metric' and 'error-rate gate' text lines collide directly with the floating status pill and action buttons.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom inset padding to the terminal content viewport so logs do not render behind overlay controls.
